revisionScope: Uncommitted October 13 hardening build. Selected initial source and generated Worker hashes captured at 18:55:32Z; concurrent root fixes are recorded as narrow rechecks, not a new grade.

scores.reason: The public preview states one CV, one vacancy, human review and separate optional saving. Discovery and application-status claims carry visible limits.

A guest can start without an account or card. The independently exercised fictional journey reached a real one-page PDF preview; cloud activation is supported by supplied synthetic QA, not my own signed-in browser run.
Import/paste and three required setup details reduce initial effort. Individual claim context, contribution and sharing checks remain substantial, and a full vacancy still needs copying.

Literal complete passages, source references, assisted-role qualifiers and forecast limitations are preserved. The initial internship context inheritance and decorated vacancy heading reproduce misleading labels or unnecessary review noise.

Source saving, vacancy preparation, exact preview, approval, multiple output formats, tracking, reminders and recurring controls form a coherent loop. Hosted rules execution is supplied evidence. External inbox/model operation was not independently exercised.

Career facts and unchanged packets are reusable; a second free-check vacancy deliberately clears findings and approval. Supplied hosted QA demonstrates fact reuse. No measured customer time saving is inferred.

Task help, original guides, interactive fictional walkthroughs, keyboard step controls and complete transcripts exist. The current video manifest is empty; avatar/recorded assets are in production and were not treated as ready.

The observed desktop journey has labelled fields, readable progress, semantic controls and focus handoffs. Claim/output review is dense. Full mobile, assistive-technology and playback testing are outside this independent run.

Separate storage, sharing, model-route and mailbox choices, server-only model keys, owner checks, anonymous denials and conservative output claims are strong. Signed-link lifetime, retention and downloaded-copy limits remain material operational boundaries.

Database invariants and selected suites passed, with explicit partial/blocked results and retained uncertain spending. The initial slow-model lease mismatch, accepted paid-schedule route mismatch and unbounded stalled download are reproducible recovery gaps.

boundaryConclusions.conclusion: Database CAS, source/input versions, exact reviewed text and approval hashes prevent stale factual publication/download. Claim withdrawal and source corrections revoke export authority, including reported application history. UI clears factual/disclosure choices after edits.

Control derives owner from authenticated identity. Repository reads and private paths are owner-scoped, service RPCs are revoked from browsers, and API/Blob responses recheck current owner. Anonymous private endpoint requests independently denied. No candidate account or foreign private record was opened.

Cleared literal claims preserve contribution, negation and forecast qualifications; model input uses eligible phrasing/context plus vacancy, not raw CV/name/contact. Excluded terms suppress/redact output material; the raw saved source still requires user redaction as documented. Initial context classifier gap is R1.

5 MiB upload, 80–60,000 readable characters, 100 PDF pages, UTF-8 TXT, and 2 MiB actual inflated DOCX document XML bounds are present. DOCX ignores external relationships/macros, denies DTD/entities and forged-size ZIP bombs. PDF scans/no OCR, corrupt/password-protected and unsupported glyph/page failures have actionable alternatives. DOCX/TXT can remain usable independently of PDF.

Server verifies stored bytes against the manifest before issuing 120-second owner-path links; no public bucket. Expired requests can get a fresh link, and source changes deny new links. Previously issued signed links/downloaded copies cannot be retroactively recalled. Stalled browser request recovery is R4.

Model/provider keys remain server-side. Frontend production validation rejects privileged Supabase keys. Candidate/search and admin reservations share the same monthly locked ledger capped at US$50 and owner-configured lower caps; uncertain reservations retain spending and cannot be blindly replayed. Admin review batch cap is US$5. Erasure does not refund committed paid usage. No real funded call was made by this auditor.

Sending and application submission are unsupported control actions. Gmail drafts need separately confirmed recipient/attachment and connection permission; Gmail was not connected here. Source disables checkout unless explicitly configured; supplied hosted QA reports disabled real-money checkout and anonymous actual checkout denied.

Recurring opt-in, timezone-aware future instants, durable occurrence/lease identity, active-user limits and authoritative pause/cancel guards are present. Missed windows prepare once rather than flooding catch-up runs. Current UI is rules-only. Source failures are reported partial/blocked rather than success or an empty market. R2/R3 concern model-related runtime/API edges.

The generated Worker passed noindex headers for private/auth/admin routes and all 38 public rendered routes; robots excludes private roots and sitemap includes public pages. The actual domain still serves older generic initial HTML and lacks a /loop X-Robots-Tag at the observed time; this is a release gap, not failure of the new generated Worker. ROLLBACK.md specifies version 14, f225/tag, exact saved Site identity, preserved data/configuration/usage and function rollback checks.

highestValueFixes.title: Keep the database run lease longer than the bounded model operation
highestValueFixes.reproduction: With the initial 100-second SQL lease, simulate a valid OpenRouter response at 101 seconds. The real runtime settles one usage row and uploads five artifacts, then phase commit is denied. In a fresh in-memory PostgreSQL instance, the old lease also rejects a simulated 101-second commit.
highestValueFixes.impact: A successful billed model result can fail to publish until recovery or another explicit resume. A competing recovery worker may observe an in-flight reservation and block conservatively.
highestValueFixes.acceptance: Allow a valid response inside the declared 120-second provider deadline to settle/render/commit while the lease remains authoritative. Cancellation, stale-input, owner, token and service-only RPC guards must still deny late/foreign publication. Prove it without real paid calls.
highestValueFixes.status: Local fix independently passed: additive migration extends the run lease to 180 seconds; eight database assertions passed. Hosted migration application was not independently verified.

highestValueFixes.title: Reject unsupported paid recurring schedules or persist their explicit processing route
highestValueFixes.reproduction: The backend accepts a paid daily openai/gpt-6.1-sol schedule with model consent. When OpenRouter is configured, scheduled dispatch stores only model/inbox consent. First preparation compares missing route as direct against openrouter and blocks before reservation or provider use.
highestValueFixes.impact: An accepted supported API schedule repeatedly queues work that cannot prepare. The current customer UI schedules rules only and is unaffected; this is a latent API/legacy-schedule failure, not an observed paid customer run.
highestValueFixes.acceptance: For the rules-only product, reject paid schedules explicitly before persistence/dispatch. If paid recurrence is supported later, persist and display the exact consented processing route, invalidate consent on route changes, and test routed scheduling with no provider substitution.
highestValueFixes.status: Narrow local fix passed: new paid schedule providers are rejected before persistence; rules scheduling remains functional. Existing stored paid schedules still need explicit legacy handling. Hosted updated function deployment not independently verified.

highestValueFixes.title: Bound private document requests and release stalled download controls
highestValueFixes.reproduction: Mock the signed private artifact fetch with a promise that never settles. The call receives no cancellation signal and remains pending after ten virtual minutes. The UI download busy state is cleared only when this promise settles.
highestValueFixes.impact: A stalled connection can leave review/download and refresh actions disabled with no fresh-link recovery. The existing descriptive retry errors only run after a rejection or response.
highestValueFixes.acceptance: Use a bounded request/read deadline, cancel stalled work on owner/unmount changes, clear busy state and offer a fresh signed-link retry. Keep the current approval and owner fence. Enforce the byte limit while streaming rather than only after whole-blob allocation.
highestValueFixes.status: Narrow local timeout fix passed: headers and body bounded by 45 seconds, transfer aborted, fresh-link retry succeeds, owner check retained. Streaming byte-limit enforcement and immediate owner/unmount cancellation remain separate limits.
